DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文の前に、食べられない食材はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before you order, are there any ingredients you cannot eat?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: えびにアレルギーがあります。ムツゴロウの料理なら、えびを使わずに作れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: えびアレルギーがありムツゴロウ料理にえびを使うか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am allergic to shrimp. Could the mudskipper dish be made without shrimp?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have a shrimp allergy and ask whether shrimp is used in the mudskipper dish. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 厨房に材料を確認します。たれやだしに含まれるものも確認したほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the ingredients with the kitchen. We should also check what is in the sauce and stock.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。身にえびが入っていなくても、えびを煮た汁や粉が混じると困ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: えび由来の煮汁や粉の混入も困ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Even if there is no shrimp in the fish itself, it would be a problem if liquid used to cook shrimp or shrimp powder were mixed in.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the inclusion of liquid used to cook shrimp or shrimp-derived powder would also be a problem. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認しました。この場面のたれにえびは使っていませんが、同じ調理場でえび料理も扱っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have checked. The sauce used here does not contain shrimp, but shrimp dishes are also handled in the same kitchen.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 揚げる油や鍋も、えび料理と共用ですか。それが分かってから注文を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 揚げ油と鍋がえび料理と共用か聞いて注文判断を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: Are the frying oil and pots also shared with shrimp dishes? I would like to decide whether to order after finding that out.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the frying oil and pots are shared with shrimp dishes, and hold off on deciding whether to order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 揚げ油は共用です。鍋も共用のため、混入しないとお約束することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: The frying oil is shared. The pots are also shared, so we cannot promise that there will be no cross-contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうでしたか。今日は料理を頼まずに失礼します。まだ作り始めてはいませんよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料理を頼まず帰りたいと伝え調理開始前か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: I see. I will leave without ordering food today. You have not started cooking anything yet, have you?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to leave without ordering food, and check whether cooking has not yet started. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、確認前なので何も調理していません。安心して選べるお店で召し上がってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is right; we have not cooked anything because we were waiting for confirmation. Please eat at a place where you feel confident choosing your food.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 調べてくださってありがとうございます。理由を説明できて助かりました。今日は帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 材料確認へ感謝し今日は帰ると告げる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you for checking. It helped to be able to explain the reason. I will go home today.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Thank the staff for checking the ingredients and say that you will go home today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらこそ、お知らせいただきありがとうございました。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の搬入補助について確認します。朝礼の配置図は見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let us confirm your role in assisting with today's deliveries. Did you see the layout diagram at the morning briefing?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見ましたが、私は荷下ろし場の中で荷物を受け取る役だと思っていました。合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 荷下ろし場内で荷物を受け取る役だと思っていたと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: I did, but I thought my role was to receive goods inside the unloading area. Is that correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check your understanding that your role was to receive goods inside the unloading area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当は外側の受付です。クレーンの旋回範囲には入りません。運転手の受付票を受け取る役です。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your role is at reception outside the area. You will not enter the crane's slewing range. Your job is to receive the drivers' reception forms.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受付なら安全通路の入口に立つのですね。赤い柵の内側には入らない、という理解でいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 安全通路入口の受付で赤い柵内へ入らないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: If I am at reception, I will stand at the entrance to the safe walkway, then. Is it correct that I must not go inside the red fence?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will be at reception at the safe walkway entrance and will not go inside the red fence. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのとおりです。車両が止まってから指定の待機位置で対応してください。合図者の仕事はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is right. Wait until the vehicle has stopped, then handle reception from the designated waiting position. You will not act as a signaler.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 運転手に荷下ろし場所を聞かれたら、私が車を誘導してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 運転手に場所を聞かれたとき自分で車を誘導できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: If a driver asks me where to unload, may I direct the vehicle myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may direct a vehicle yourself when the driver asks where to go. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 自分で誘導せず、無線で私へ連絡してください。誘導担当が対応します。車両の進路には立たないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not direct it yourself; contact me by radio. The person assigned to guide vehicles will handle it. Do not stand in a vehicle's path.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 無線が聞こえなくなった場合は、柵のそばまで行って呼んでもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 無線が聞こえない場合に柵へ近づいて呼べるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I can no longer hear the radio, may I go up to the fence and call out?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may approach the fence and call out if you cannot hear the radio. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 近づかず、受付の安全な位置で対応を止めてください。予備の無線を渡すので、先に通信を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do not approach it; stop handling reception and stay in a safe position there. I will give you a spare radio, so let us check communication first.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付票を受け取り、行先の質問は責任者へ連絡します。通信できなければ対応を止め、区域内には入りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付票を受け行先質問を責任者へ連絡し通信不能なら止めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will receive the reception forms and contact the person in charge about destination questions. If I cannot communicate, I will stop handling reception and will not enter the area.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will receive reception forms, contact the person in charge about destination questions, and stop if communication is unavailable. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できました。まず予備の無線で試してください。安全に進めましょう。それでは、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: That is confirmed. First, test the spare radio. Let us proceed safely. Off you go, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所変更の受付内容をこちらの控えでご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please check the details of your address-change submission on this copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 番地は合っていますが、建物名と部屋番号が抜けています。ここまで追加してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 控えの番地は合うが建物名と部屋番号を追加してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: The street address is correct, but the building name and room number are missing. Could you add those as well?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the street address on the copy is correct, but you would like the building name and room number added. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 修正します。新しい住所が分かる書類と、記入した住所を見比べてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will correct it. May I compare the address you entered with documents showing your new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 在留カードの裏に新住所があります。建物名はカードにないので、この賃貸契約書も出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 在留カード裏面と建物名のある賃貸契約書を出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: My new address is on the back of my residence card. The building name is not on the card, so I will also provide this rental agreement.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Provide the back of your residence card and the rental agreement showing the building name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。この学習場面では担当者が二つの書類を確認します。連絡先の電話番号は今のままでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. In this learning scenario, the person in charge checks both documents. May we leave your contact telephone number as it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話番号も変わりました。古い番号へ連絡が行くと困るので、一緒に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 古い番号への連絡を避けるため番号も変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: My telephone number has changed too. It would be a problem if you contacted the old number, so I would like to change it at the same time.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to change your telephone number too so that you are not contacted at the old one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 電話番号の変更欄にもご記入ください。郵送の通知は修正後の登録住所へ送る設定になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also fill in the telephone-number change section. Postal notifications are set to be sent to the corrected registered address.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今週発送予定の通知も新しい部屋へ届きますか。それとも古い住所のままですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今週発送予定の通知が新住所に届くか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: Will the notification scheduled to be sent this week also arrive at my new room? Or will it still go to the old address?
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the notification scheduled to be sent this week will arrive at the new address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発送処理が済んだ通知は変更が間に合わない場合があります。今週の分は担当部署へ確認し、結果をご連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: If a notification has already been processed for dispatch, the change may not be made in time. I will check this week's notification with the relevant department and contact you with the result.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では住所と電話番号をこの内容で申請します。今週の通知については、新しい携帯番号へ連絡してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所と番号を申請し今週の通知確認結果を新しい携帯へ求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will apply to change my address and telephone number to these details. Please contact my new mobile number about this week's notification.
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Apply to change your address and number, and ask to receive the result of the check on this week's notification at your new mobile number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 修正した控えをお渡しします。ご確認ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-041-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will give you the corrected copy. Thank you for checking. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次は市内へ向かわれますか。それとも、別の列車へお乗り換えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be heading into the city next, or transferring to another train?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新地中華街へ行きたいです。この切符で路面電車にも乗れると思って買いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新地中華街へ行き手持ち切符で路面電車も利用できると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to go to Shinchi Chinatown. I bought this ticket thinking I could use it on the tram as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to go to Shinchi Chinatown and thought your ticket could also be used on the tram. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 拝見します。この切符はここまでの鉄道区間です。路面電車の運賃は別に必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me take a look. This ticket covers the railway journey up to here. You will need to pay the tram fare separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうだったのですね。鉄道のホームから直接、路面電車へ移れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 鉄道ホームから路面電車へ直接移れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. Can I transfer directly from the railway platform to the tram?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can transfer directly from the railway platform to the tram. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一度改札を出て、乗り場へ向かいます。乗換えの案内図にある緑の矢印をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need to leave through the ticket gates first, then go to the tram stop. Please look at the green arrows on the transfer guide map.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 改札でこの切符を入れると戻ってきませんか。記念に残したいのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 改札で切符が回収されるか聞き残したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I put this ticket into the gate, will it not come back? I would like to keep it as a souvenir.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the ticket will be collected at the gate and say that you would like to keep it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 使用済みの切符を残したい場合は、自動改札へ入れる前に有人改札でご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you want to keep a used ticket, please ask at the staffed gate before putting it into the automatic gate.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では有人改札へ行きます。路面電車に乗る前に、別の切符を買う場所もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 有人改札を利用し路面電車の切符購入場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will go to the staffed gate. Is there also a place to buy another ticket before boarding the tram?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will use the staffed gate, and ask where to buy a tram ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この乗り場では乗車前の切符は販売していません。運賃は降りる際にお支払いください。乗り場の表示で使える支払方法を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: This stop does not sell tickets before boarding. Please pay the fare when you get off. Check the signs at the stop for the payment methods you can use.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 切符を機械に入れずに係員へ見せます。その後、緑の矢印で乗り場へ行き支払方法を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切符を有人改札で見せてから緑の矢印で乗り場へ行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the ticket to a staff member without putting it into the machine. Then I will follow the green arrows to the stop and check the payment methods.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will show your ticket at the staffed gate and then follow the green arrows to the stop. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 有人改札はこちらです。どうぞお気をつけて、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staffed gate is this way. Take care and enjoy your journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次回の受診予約についてご相談ですね。今の予約日はいつでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss your next medical appointment. When is your current appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週火曜の午前です。月曜の夜から火曜の朝まで夜勤が入ったので、眠らずに受診するのがつらくて変更したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 来週火曜午前の予約が月曜夜からの夜勤直後になり眠らず受診するのがつらいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is next Tuesday morning. I have been assigned a night shift from Monday night until Tuesday morning, so attending without any sleep would be difficult and I would like to change it.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that next Tuesday morning's appointment falls immediately after a night shift starting Monday night, and that attending without sleep would be difficult. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 診療科の予約担当に空きを確認します。火曜以外なら、どの曜日がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will ask the department's appointment staff about availability. Other than Tuesday, which day would suit you?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 来週金曜なら休みです。ただ、その次の勤務表がまだ出ていないので、二週間後は約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 来週金曜は休みだがその次の勤務表は未定と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am off next Friday. However, the following work schedule has not come out yet, so I cannot commit to a date two weeks from now.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you are off next Friday, but that the following work schedule is not yet decided. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず来週金曜の候補を確認しましょう。予約票に次回検査の記載はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the possibilities for next Friday first. Does your appointment slip mention any tests for the next visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 採血と書いてあります。日を変えると、検査だけ元の日に受けることになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 採血が予約変更で別日になるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says blood sampling. If I change the date, would I have to have just the test on the original date?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether the blood sampling would be on a separate day if the appointment is changed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 検査と診察の順序は医師の指示を確認する必要があります。こちらで勝手に分けることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We need to check the doctor's instructions on the order of the test and consultation. We cannot separate them on our own.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では元の予約を消す前に、両方まとめて金曜へ移せるか聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約を消す前に採血と診察をまとめて金曜へ移せるか聞いてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then before canceling the original appointment, please ask whether both can be moved together to Friday.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to check whether blood sampling and the consultation can be moved together to Friday before canceling the appointment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その希望を担当者へ伝えます。調整が済むまで火曜の予約はそのままにし、連絡時に日時を再確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that request to the person in charge. We will leave the Tuesday appointment as it is until the arrangements are settled, and confirm the date and time again when we contact you.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元の予約を残してくださると助かります。金曜へ移せる場合だけ、採血の時間も一緒に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元予約を残し変更可能なら採血時間も教えてほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: It would help if you kept the original appointment. Only if it can be moved to Friday, please also tell me the blood-sampling time.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you want to keep the original appointment and, if the change is possible, would also like to know the blood-sampling time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者からの連絡をお待ちください。予約票はお返しします。お大事に、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait to hear from the person in charge. Here is your appointment slip back. Take care of yourself; goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 袋はお持ちでしょうか。卵のパックはほかの商品と分けて置いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a bag? I have set the carton of eggs apart from the other products.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋を車に忘れました。この店のかごを駐車場まで持っていってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋を車に忘れ店のかごを駐車場まで持ち出せるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my bag in the car. May I take the store's basket out to the parking lot?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you left your bag in the car and ask whether you can take the store basket to the parking lot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 店のかごは持ち出せません。お買物用の袋を買うか、商品をお預かりして袋を取りに行くことはできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The store baskets cannot be taken outside. You can buy a shopping bag, or we can hold your purchases while you go and get your bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 車まで戻る時間がないので、袋を一枚買います。卵が下敷きにならないように入れてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 戻る時間がないので一枚買い卵を上に入れてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not have time to go back to the car, so I will buy one bag. Could you pack it so that the eggs are not underneath anything?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you do not have time to go back, so will buy one bag, and ask for the eggs to be packed on top. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 重い牛乳を先に入れ、卵は上へ置きます。袋は五円です。お支払いは何になさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will put the heavy milk in first and place the eggs on top. The bag costs five yen. How would you like to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: スマートフォンで払いたいです。ただ、電池が一パーセントなので画面が消えるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: スマートフォン払いを希望し残電池一パーセントと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to pay with my smartphone. However, the battery is at one percent, so the screen might go off.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to pay with your smartphone and explain that the battery is at one percent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 決済完了の表示が出るまで操作をお願いします。切れてしまったら、決済状況を確認してから別の方法にしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please continue until the payment-complete message appears. If the phone goes off, let us check the payment status before switching to another method.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二回払うことにならないようにしたいです。今画面が消えましたが、決済は済んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 画面が消えたため決済済みか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to avoid paying twice. The screen has just gone off; has the payment been completed?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the payment is complete because the screen has gone off. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: レジには未完了と出ています。まだお支払いは成立していないので、現金でもお支払いいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The register shows it as incomplete. The payment has not gone through yet, so you can pay in cash as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では現金で払います。卵を上にした袋を受け取り、店のかごはここへ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未完了を受け現金で払い袋を受取り店のかごを戻すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will pay in cash. I will take the bag with the eggs on top and return the store basket here.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Following confirmation that payment is incomplete, say that you will pay in cash, take the bag, and return the store basket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お会計が済みました。袋の底も支えてお持ちください。ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your payment is complete. Please support the bottom of the bag as you carry it. Thank you very much. We hope to see you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品のことでしょうか。まだ召し上がっていないものを、こちらへ置いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about a product? Could you place the item you have not eaten here?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 朝買ったパンを開けたら、表面に青い包装のようなものが付いていました。まだ食べていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝買ったパンに青い包装片のようなものが付きまだ食べていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I opened the bread I bought this morning, there was something like blue packaging stuck to the surface. I have not eaten it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that something like a piece of blue packaging is stuck to the bread you bought this morning and that you have not eaten it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのまま確認します。見つけたものを取り除かず、袋も一緒に残していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check it as it is. Could you leave what you found in place without removing it, and keep the bag as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。ここに付いたままです。レシートはないですが、買ったのは八時ごろです。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 異物が付いたままでレシートはなく八時ごろ購入したと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It is still stuck here. I do not have the receipt, but I bought it at around eight o'clock.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that the foreign object is still attached, you do not have the receipt, and you bought it at around eight o'clock. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入時刻を控えます。責任者が商品の状態と販売記録を確認します。体調に変化はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will note the purchase time. The person in charge will check the product's condition and the sales records. Have you noticed any change in how you feel?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 食べていないので変化はありません。このパンを交換してもらう場合、同じ商品になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未喫食で変化がなく交換が同じ商品になるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not eaten it, so there has been no change. If this bread is exchanged, would it be for the same product?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not eaten it and have noticed no change in how you feel, and ask whether an exchange would be for the same product. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対応は責任者の確認後にご相談します。同じ商品をご希望でなければ、そのことも伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will discuss how to handle it after the person in charge checks it. If you do not want the same product, we can pass that on as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 原因が分からない間は同じものを食べたくありません。返金を希望すると伝えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原因不明の間は同じパンを食べたくなく返金を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not want to eat the same kind while the cause is unknown. Could you tell them I would like a refund?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you do not want to eat the same bread while the cause is unknown and would like a refund. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。返金希望として引き継ぎます。確認中は商品をお預かりし、連絡先も伺ってよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I will pass this on as a refund request. May we keep the product during the check and also take your contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 商品と袋はお渡しします。この電話番号へ連絡してください。返金が決まるまでは待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品と袋を渡し電話連絡を希望し返金判断を待つと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give you the product and the bag. Please contact me at this telephone number. I will wait until a decision about the refund is made.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer that you will hand over the product and bag, would like to be contacted by phone, and will wait for the refund decision. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご心配をおかけしました。責任者からご連絡します。お申し出ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am sorry for causing you concern. The person in charge will contact you. Thank you for bringing this to our attention. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お引越しの手続きですね。前の住所は、この市の外でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are here for moving procedures. Was your previous address outside this city?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 福岡から越してきました。会社も変わったので、住所と勤務先を一枚の書類で変えられると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 福岡から転居し会社も変わり同じ書類で変更すると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I moved here from Fukuoka. I have also changed companies, and I thought I could change my address and employer using one document.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you moved from Fukuoka and changed companies, and thought the changes could be made with the same document. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住民登録の手続きと、勤務先で行う届出は別です。まず転入の受付に必要なものを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Resident registration procedures and notifications made at your workplace are separate. First, let us check what you need to register your move into the city.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前の市でもらった書類と在留カードがあります。家族は来月来ますが、今から一緒に届けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前市の書類と在留カードを持ち来月来る家族も今届けられるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the documents I received from my previous city and my residence card. My family will come next month; can I notify you about them together with me now?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have documents from your previous city and your residence card, and ask whether you can also notify them now about family arriving next month. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実際に住み始める時期を分けて確認します。ご家族分は転入担当へ、来月の予定としてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check separately when each person actually starts living here. Please ask the staff handling move-in registrations about your family as a plan for next month.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は私だけの手続きを進めたいです。新住所は契約書の部屋番号まで書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日は自分だけ進め新住所に部屋番号を含めるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Today I would like to proceed with just my own registration. Should I write my new address including the room number from the rental agreement?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will proceed with only your own registration today, and check whether the new address should include the room number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お住まいの住所を部屋番号まで記入してください。契約上の住所と居住先が同じかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please enter your residential address including the room number. We will also check whether the address in the agreement is the same as where you live.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じです。会社から住所を証明する書類を持ってくるよう言われましたが、転入の控えで足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 契約住所と同じと答え会社へ出す住所証明が控えで足りるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is the same. My company told me to bring a document proving my address; will the copy of my move-in submission be enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that the address is the same as in the agreement and ask whether the submission copy is enough as proof of address for your company. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会社が必要としている書類の名称を確認してください。控えで足りるかは会社の判断です。住民票が必要なら別に申請します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the name of the document your company requires. It is up to the company whether that copy is sufficient. If you need a copy of your resident record, you apply for it separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に自分の転入を済ませます。会社には書類名を聞き、家族の分は担当者へ来月の予定として相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の転入を先に済ませ会社へ書類名を聞き家族は別途相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will finish my own move-in registration first. I will ask my company for the document's name and consult the person in charge about my family as a plan for next month.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will finish your own move-in registration first, ask your company for the document's name, and consult separately about your family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 順番が整理できましたね。転入担当の番号札をどうぞ。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Now we have clarified the order. Here is a numbered ticket for the move-in registration staff. Thank you for asking us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票をお持ちですね。受取人のお名前を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a missed-delivery notice. Please let me check the recipient's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所と部屋番号は私の家ですが、名前は知らない人です。私が再配達を頼んでもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所は自宅だが知らない氏名の不在票を再配達してよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The address and room number are my home's, but the name belongs to someone I do not know. May I request redelivery?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may request redelivery for a notice with your home address but an unfamiliar name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人宛てではないので、受け取る前に配達担当へ確認します。このお名前の方は一緒に住んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Since it is not addressed to you, we will check with the delivery staff before you receive it. Does anyone with this name live with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住んでいません。先月引っ越したので、前の入居者かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛名の人とは同居せず先月転居したため前入居者かもしれないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I moved in last month, so it may be the previous resident.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the addressee does not live with you and may be the previous resident because you moved in last month. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その状況を担当へ伝えます。お客様の氏名を受取人として書き換えることはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the person in charge about those circumstances. Please do not change the recipient's name to your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書き換えてはいません。配達員が来たら、私の荷物ではないと説明すればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書き換えていないと答え自分の荷物でないと伝えてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not changed it. If the delivery worker comes, should I explain that it is not my parcel?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that you have not changed the name and ask whether you should explain that it is not your parcel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、別の方宛てで同居していないと伝えてください。今ここからも配達担当へ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please tell them it is addressed to someone else who does not live with you. We will also notify the delivery staff from here now.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この不在票は窓口へ渡したほうがいいですか。個人の荷物なので写真を送るのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 個人の荷物の写真送信を避け現物を窓口へ渡せるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Would it be better to hand this notice over at the counter? Since it concerns someone's personal parcel, I would rather not send a photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to avoid sending a photo concerning someone's personal parcel and ask whether you can hand the original over at the counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現物を確認して担当へ引き継げます。追跡番号と宛名の情報があるため、公開せずお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can check the original and pass it to the person in charge. It has a tracking number and addressee information, so please hand it over without making it public.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 現物をこちらへ渡します。知らない人の荷物を受け取らず、配達が来たら別人宛てと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現物を渡し荷物を受取らず配達員へ別人宛てと伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give you the original here. I will not accept a stranger's parcel, and if a delivery arrives, I will say it is addressed to someone else.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer that you will hand over the original, not receive the parcel, and tell the delivery worker that it is addressed to someone else. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。担当へ確認を依頼します。ご連絡ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will ask the person in charge to check. Thank you for contacting us. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードについてのご相談ですね。紛失の連絡はすでにされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to ask about your card. Have you already reported it lost?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨夜電話で止めてもらいましたが、今朝自分の車で見つかりました。そのまま使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨夜紛失停止したカードが車で見つかりそのまま使えるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I had it blocked by phone last night, but I found it in my own car this morning. Can I use it as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you found in your car a card you had blocked as lost last night, and ask whether you can use it as it is. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 停止したままか確認が必要です。見つかったカードと、ご本人確認の書類をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check whether it is still blocked. Do you have the card you found and identification documents with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両方あります。なくしたのはキャッシュカードだけで、通帳はずっと家にありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カードと本人確認書類を持ち通帳は紛失していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have both. Only the cash card was lost; my passbook was at home the whole time.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have the card and identification documents, and that your passbook was not lost. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。停止を解除できるか、再発行が必要かは、手続き状況を調べてからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. We will check the status of the procedure before explaining whether the block can be lifted or a replacement is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨夜の電話で再発行もお願いした気がします。二枚のカードが使えるようにならないか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話で再発行も頼んだ可能性があり二枚有効にならないか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I think I may also have requested a replacement over the phone last night. I am worried that two cards could become usable.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you may also have requested a replacement over the phone and ask about your concern that two cards could be active. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手続き記録を確認します。古いカードを勝手に処分せず、お預かりするまで手元に残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the procedure records. Do not dispose of the old card on your own; keep it with you until we take it.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日ATMで試すのはやめます。再発行が進んでいたら、振込みの受取も止まりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ATMで試さず再発行中でも振込入金を受けられるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not try it at an ATM today. If the replacement is already being processed, will incoming transfers also be stopped?
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not test it at an ATM, and ask whether you can receive bank transfers while a replacement is being processed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: カードの停止と口座への入金は別の確認事項です。入金制限の有無も担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The card being blocked and money being credited to the account are separate things to check. We will also ask the person in charge whether there are any restrictions on incoming funds.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ではカードは試さずにお渡しします。停止と再発行の状況、それから入金の制限を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: カードを渡し停止と再発行の状態と入金制限を調べてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will hand over the card without trying it. Please check the status of the block and replacement, as well as any restrictions on incoming funds.
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the card and ask the staff to check the block and replacement status, and any restrictions on incoming funds. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認が済んだら担当者からご説明します。ご相談ありがとうございました。ひとまず失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-042-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: The person in charge will explain once the checks are complete. Thank you for consulting us. Please excuse me for now.
